lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: High above the clouds, the Highcliff Open begins. Nine peaks. One ring. Every fighter in the world wants in.

lines.speaker: char_tavi_001
lines.text: We made it! Lark, Dunmore, look at that ring! I'm gonna win it!

lines.speaker: char_lark_001
lines.text: We're late, the gate's closing, and you're already shouting. Classic.

lines.speaker: char_rook_001
lines.text: Three nobodies from the valley? I count... zero chances. Turn around.

lines.speaker: char_dunmore_001
lines.text: He seems confident. I'm sorry, Tavi, but you did ask for this.

lines.speaker: char_tavi_001
lines.text: Zero chances? Then watch me light one up!

lines.speaker: char_rook_001
lines.text: Lucky. That was lucky. I want a rematch, and I'll bring a partner.

lines.speaker: char_tavi_001
lines.text: Bring ten! We'll still burn through!

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Announcer
lines.text: WHAT AN UPSET! The valley trio is IN THE TOURNAMENT!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Far above, a single star blinks out. Nobody notices. Yet.

lines.speaker: npc
lines.name: Announcer
lines.text: Round two! Rook returns with the Lantern Monk, Pell! Tag match, folks!

lines.speaker: char_pell_001
lines.text: I heal anyone who falls. I also bet Rook a week of dishes that we win.

lines.speaker: char_rook_001
lines.text: Two of us. Every move counted. This time, no luck.

lines.speaker: char_lark_001
lines.text: Good, I could use a real workout. Dunmore, guard my back?

lines.speaker: char_dunmore_001
lines.text: Always. Sorry in advance, Mister Monk.

lines.speaker: char_pell_001
lines.text: Dishes for a week... Well fought, valley friends.

lines.speaker: char_rook_001
lines.text: I miscounted. That's... never happened before.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lanterns on the bridge flicker, then turn violet. The sky above the ring begins to go dark.

lines.speaker: char_tavi_001
lines.text: Uh... is the sun supposed to do that?

lines.speaker: char_thessa_001
lines.text: The tournament is over. My king claims every aura on this mountain.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Behind her, figures rise from the shadows: perfect, empty copies of Rook and Pell.

lines.speaker: char_rook_001
lines.text: Hey! That's MY face! Nobody copies my moves!

lines.speaker: char_thessa_001
lines.text: Umbral echoes. They fight like your friends, but they feel nothing.

lines.speaker: char_tavi_001
lines.text: Then we'll knock some feeling into them! Team, let's go!

lines.speaker: char_thessa_001
lines.text: You broke them... with that much heart? Interesting.

lines.speaker: char_thessa_001
lines.text: Corvane waits at the summit. The champion stands in your way. Go, if you dare.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Thessa melts into the dark. For a moment, she looks almost relieved.

lines.speaker: char_lark_001
lines.text: The champion? Solenne herself? Today just keeps getting better.

lines.speaker: char_solenne_001
lines.text: Nine years I have held this ring. I will not send children to face a king.

lines.speaker: char_tavi_001
lines.text: We're not children! We beat his shadows!

lines.speaker: char_solenne_001
lines.text: Then prove it. Beat Rook, Pell and me. If you can, the summit is yours.

lines.speaker: char_rook_001
lines.text: Round three. This time I count better.

lines.speaker: char_dunmore_001
lines.text: Oh dear. The champion. I'll apologize extra hard.

lines.speaker: char_solenne_001
lines.text: Ha... HA! It has been years since anyone made me sweat!

lines.speaker: char_solenne_001
lines.text: Go. But know this: Corvane wants my aura most of all. Do not let him take it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lightning splits the summit. A crown of black shards hangs in the sky.

lines.speaker: char_corvane_001
lines.text: How kind of you to tire her out for me.

lines.speaker: char_corvane_001
lines.text: Welcome, little sparks. My herald. My new shadow. And me. A three-course meal.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Behind him stands an umbral echo of Solenne, glowing with stolen sunlight.

lines.speaker: char_thessa_001
lines.text: ...Forgive me. I still serve the crown. For now.

lines.speaker: char_tavi_001
lines.text: You took the champion's light? I'm taking it BACK!

lines.speaker: char_lark_001
lines.text: Final delivery, everyone. Make it loud!

lines.speaker: char_dunmore_001
lines.text: For once, I'm not sorry at all.

lines.speaker: char_corvane_001
lines.text: My crown... cracked by a mechanic, a courier and a quarryman? Impossible!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The shard crown shatters. Stolen auras rush back across the nine peaks like dawn.

lines.speaker: char_thessa_001
lines.text: He's gone. I... think I'm free. Thank you.

lines.speaker: char_rook_001
lines.text: Fine. I counted every hit. You earned it. I'm on your team now.

lines.speaker: char_tavi_001
lines.text: WOOO! Next year, we win the whole tournament!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A new fighter joins you: Rook, the Thousand-Step Rook!
